address: Hôtel 5 Terres, 11 place de l'Hôtel-de-Ville, Barr, 67140, France
bio: This contemporary restaurant located within the 5 Terres Hotel looks out over the magnificent Renaissance town hall (1640). In a light-filled space done out in premium materials, you can enjoy contemporary cuisine that brings the best out of carefully sourced local ingredients. The wine list is particularly impressive, featuring hundreds of organic and biodynamic labels....
